name: How can I make my guest bathroom feel more spacious?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my guest bathroom feel more spacious?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a guest bathroom feel more spacious, consider several design strategies. Opt for a light color palette on walls and floors to reflect light and visually expand the room. Install a floating vanity or a pedestal sink to free up floor space, and use a frameless glass shower enclosure instead of a bulky curtain. Large format tiles with minimal grout lines can also create a sense of continuity. Incorporating ample lighting, including task and ambient options, and large mirrors can further enhance the perception of space.
acceptedAnswer.description: To make a guest bathroom feel more spacious, use light colors, floating vanities or pedestal sinks, frameless glass shower enclosures, large format tiles, and ample lighting with large mirrors.
